import json
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from datetime import datetime 
import os
def make_line_graph(x,y,title,filename):
    plt.figure()
    plt.plot(x,y)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel('Students----->')
    plt.ylabel('Marks---->')
    plt.xticks(rotation=75,fontsize=7)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(filename)
    plt.close()
    return

def make_histogram(data,title,filename):
    plt.figure()
    plt.hist(data,bins=range(0,101,10))
    plt.title(title)
    plt.savefig(filename)
    plt.close()
    return

def make_scatter_plot(x,y,title,filename):
    plt.figure()
    plt.scatter(x,y)
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel('Students----->')
    plt.ylabel('Marks---->')
    plt.xticks(rotation=75,fontsize=7)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(filename)
    plt.close()
    return

def make_bar_chart(data,x,y,title,filename):
    plt.figure()
    data=data.sort_values(by=x)
    plt.bar(data[x],data[y])
    plt.title(title)
    plt.xlabel('Students----->')
    plt.ylabel('Marks---->')
    plt.xticks(rotation=90,fontsize=7)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(filename)
    plt.close()
    return
